page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head top right "Pag. I" above the title. Title block centred, then a rule, then the heading BREVIARIUM, then a list of numbered lines in italic. Catchword-like signature "A" and the start "IX. Epi-" at the foot, bottom right.

page.notes: Title page style layout with large capitals; the "Pag. I" at top right is a printed page marker. The final line "IX. Epi-" is a catchword-like line at the foot; the signature "A" stands at bottom left of it. Some roman numerals in the list (e.g. "III.", "VI.") are uncertain in the scan and may be misread. Long s rendered as s throughout.
